entries.title: Salt and Sanctuary
entries.definitive_edition: Salt and Sanctuary on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best archival route because it preserves the complete game with native PC capture/settings flexibility. The Switch Drowned Tome Edition is a nice physical package with manual, poster/map, and soundtrack code, but it is not a gameplay-content advantage over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Salt and Sanctuary on Steam for Windows PC and play the native PC release. Use the Switch Drowned Tome Edition only if you specifically want the physical extras.

all_releases.reason: primary: complete game with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No gameplay-content-exclusive port is documented; physical extras on Switch do not require a secondary playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or gameplay-expanded edition is documented; Switch Drowned Tome Edition is a physical collector package.

entries.title: Salt and Sacrifice
entries.definitive_edition: Salt and Sacrifice on Windows PC with The Traitor's Tomb update

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with online multiplayer/cross-play update support.

primary.version: Steam/Epic current build with The Shunned Namekeeper and The Traitor's Tomb updates
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best version because it covers the current complete content state, including the later Steam release, The Shunned Namekeeper update, and the free The Traitor's Tomb update, while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility. PlayStation and Switch routes do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over the current PC build.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Salt and Sacrifice on Steam for Windows PC and update to the current build. Confirm The Shunned Namekeeper and The Traitor's Tomb content is present before a full completion run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release via Epic first and Steam later; current build includes the major free updates.
